premises.text: A data-driven fundability score diagnoses and guides improvement of a company's raise readiness
premises.evidence_span: This is a score that looks at a company's data and compares it with the data of companies that have successfully and unsuccessfully raised capital

premises.text: The underlying dataset is the world's largest small private-offerings set layered with US and global sources
premises.evidence_span: the largest data set of small private offerings in the world

premises.text: Platform economics: free signup for investors/issuers and a 2% success fee on closed deals via broker-dealer
premises.evidence_span: For investors or issuers to sign up on the site, it's free. For any deals that transact on the platform, we take a 2% success fee

premises.text: Active institutional and private-office investors on the platform seek companies to fund
premises.evidence_span: We've seen investors from private offices, Bain Capital, Credit Suisse, or Goldman Sachs who are already using the platform

premises.text: Global partnerships feed listed opportunities from multiple countries onto the site
premises.evidence_span: bring in deals from multiple countries that have all gone through the process of getting on the site

value.text: CEOs improve raise odds and connect with capital on Offerboard
value.evidence_span: what they can do to improve that score

causal_links.evidence_span: improve your fundability as a company
They're looking for companies to invest in

notes: truncated=true. Market-size claims excluded as framing. Named investor brands support the investor-presence premise as mechanism, not pure traction metrics.
